overview.en:
Read and manage Redis keys, data structures and supported search features with Redis’s official MCP server.

Inspect the selected Redis data and command context before preparing changes. Identify key patterns and data types rather than treating every key as a plain string.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Redis 官方 MCP 服务读取和管理键、数据结构及受支持的搜索功能。

准备修改前检查选定 Redis 数据与命令上下文，识别键模式和数据类型，不把所有键都视为普通字符串。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Inspect these Redis keys and explain their data types.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 检查这些 Redis 键，并解释数据类型。

starterPrompts.en: Help diagnose this Redis data or command issue.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 协助排查这个 Redis 数据或命令问题。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a scoped data update plan without executing it yet.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备范围明确的数据更新方案，先不要执行。

descriptions.en: Use Redis database tools in Ghast to inspect keys, data structures and supported search features. 使用 Redis 数据库工具查询键、数据结构及搜索功能。
